notes: Created from the 2026-10-19 HuggingFace discovery crawl. Benchmarks are the card's own published rows (vendor claims). architecture and task are inferred from the slug and param ratio; KV geometry, context length and quant sizes are not yet filled, hence status draft. KV basis: text_config is MLA (KimiVLForConditionalGeneration, MoonViT tower): 27 layers x (kv_lora_rank 512 + qk_rope_head_dim 64 = 576 cached values per token per layer) x 2 B (bf16) = 31,104 B/token. V is up-projected from the same latent, so v_head_dim 128 is not cached separately and the 16 num_key_value_heads do not multiply the latent. The 27-layer MoonViT vision tower is a single forward pass and adds no per-token KV. Context 131,072 = text_config max_position_embeddings (matches the card's max_model_len 131072). REVIEWED 2026-10-21: card confirms every claimed row. All 8 rows match the card table's Kimi-VL-A3B-Thinking-2506 column (MMVet 78.1 per table, not 78.4 in text).
